verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Jeremiah 25

Fourth year of Jehoiakim = 605 BC, Nebuchadnezzar's first; possibly between Carchemish and his return to Babylon; "my servant" (absent in the LXX); seventy years: round number 605–c. 536 (Harrison) or literal (Feinberg; Guzik favours literal); the "many nations and great kings" = Medes and Persians under Cyrus (Feinberg); the cup list too complete for one event — ultimate fulfilment in the final judgment (Rev 19); Sheshach as an atbash cipher for Babylon, following Jerome (with Kidner's caution)
